notes.title: 4 Language support and 7 new cars!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42505160/9c95125b214d97a2a151d12f5391f8531502c7f0.png[/img]

We have added some support for 4 languages, English, French, Italian, and Korean. We have also added 7 more cars to the game that are all very unique! 

Our next update will include a new map - the forest, some challenges that you can do to earn extra gold and we should have steam achievements working soon too! 

We hope you're all having fun Running Over Zombies!!!
